description.value:
You summon or dismiss any of your Cloth's six weapon pairs — twin swords, tridents, nunchaku, shields, sanjiegun, or tonfa.

They can never be disarmed or destroyed, and they accept weapon runes. You use your unarmed proficiency with them.

Granted by @UUID[Compendium.isaacs-hb-pf2e.saint-class-features.Item.Libra — the Weapons]
